correctness.rationale: A homomorphism has f(u)=a u; bracket preservation gives the pure-tensor condition (beta∘f)⊗(alpha∘f)=a beta⊗alpha. If a≠0 it forces f(v)=v+w0, f(W)=T(W), f(u)=a u; if a=0 the maps form two m×m linear-map strata with an r×m intersection. Inclusion-exclusion and standard Gaussian surjection counts prove the endomorphism polynomial; projection identities T²=T, ell T=ell, T w0=w0, b=ell(w0) give retractions. Comparing the two dominant q^(m²) strata to a uniform square-matrix law gives O_q(q^-m) total-variation error. Independent fresh brute checks found E_3,3=(1,56,102,12), J_3,3=(1,18,4,1) by enumerating 3^9 maps directly, also n=2 and n=3 over F2. Characteristic-two universality applies only to the explicitly defined algebra, not the cited classification theorem.
